item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03120","case1_error":"Numerically evaluates 36 × 9 as 432 instead of 324, producing an incorrect volume.","case2_error":"Numerically evaluates 12 + 15 as 33 instead of 27.","reason":"Both incorrectly evaluate a correctly specified arithmetic expression.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J03121","case1_error":"Subtracts only Ryan's quarter, omitting Chris's withdrawal.","case2_error":"Represents '$1000 less' with +1000 instead of −1000 in the sale-price equation.","reason":"One omits a required withdrawal; the other reverses the direction of a stated monetary adjustment.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03122","case1_error":"Counts ten ads total instead of ten for each of three companies, omitting the factor of three.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates division by the stated bundle price as two pieces; $14 buys seven bundles, or 21 pieces.","reason":"The first omits the number of companies; the second gives an incorrect numerical evaluation involving the bundle rate.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03123","case1_error":"Treats 90 seconds per ear as 90 seconds per cat, omitting the second ear.","case2_error":"Sets feeding cost equal to purchase cost, ignoring the stated 20% increase.","reason":"Omitting repeated units differs from omitting a percentage increase to a baseline cost.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03124","case1_error":"Misidentifies selling price as construction cost and subtracts the extra $100,000 twice.","case2_error":"Divides Billy's already calculated 80% tip contribution by two without justification.","reason":"The first conflates price with cost and double-counts an expense; the second imposes an equal split after calculating the specified share.","judgment":"different"}]}
